mathematics.assertion_tested: Uniform-law binomial weights, exact grid Wasserstein error, beta-binomial displacement bound and exact preservation of the uniform density; analytic singular-TV negative controls.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q, exact Fraction arithmetic and integer polynomial coefficients.
mathematics.conventions: Conditional B~Binomial(K,t), Y|B~Beta(B+1,K-B+1); TV is half the L1 norm on densities.
inputs: Every K=1..100; exact Bernstein partition of unity and beta moments.
non_claims: No uniform TV rate without an explicit modulus for the compact density family.
The two TV=1 controls are proved by mutual singularity, not approximated numerically.
